title: POST /api/devices/activate request of a Suderra OS agent
description: The activation request of a device on the Suderra OS channel (channels.json activation, ADR-048 DEC-5.7, DEC-5.8, DEC-10). It keeps the member names of the cloud's DeviceActivationRequest (camelCase) and adds what the Suderra OS flow needs: deviceBinding, the hardware binding root recorded (identity.json device_binding), which the cloud compares with the binding the manifest reservation was made for, so a token alone never activates another device; and installedManifest, the statement digest of the manifest root installed (identity.json device.installed_manifest), so the cloud names exactly that manifest in the activation receipt even when the device fetched more than one. The fingerprint carries no machine-id and no CPU serial: Suderra OS has no machine-id identity (DEC-4.9) and the binding replaces both. The token is the single-use provisioning token the technician used; it is never logged. Generic-channel devices keep the legacy request, which this schema does not describe.

macAddresses.description: SHA-256 of each interface's MAC address, lowercase hex; raw MAC addresses are never sent.
